ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: Figure-I on the left side of the attached figure is a 4-bit ripple-carry adder, formed by cascading 4 FA blocks; the rightmost FA is connected to the least significant bits X0,Y0 and the input carry Z0, producing Z1, Z2, and Z3 successively to the left, the leftmost side outputs the final carry Z4, and the bottom of each stage outputs S0 to S3. Figure-II on the right side of the attached figure is a full-adder structure: Xi and Yi first enter XOR to obtain the propagate signal Pi, then enter a second XOR with Zi to obtain Si; meanwhile Xi and Yi enter AND to obtain the generate term Gi, Pi and Zi enter another AND, and the outputs of the two ANDs then pass through OR to obtain Zi+1. The problem gives XOR, AND, and OR delays as 20 ns, 15 ns, and 10 ns respectively. Reasoning: the inputs change at t=0 to X3X2X1X0=1100, Y3Y2Y1Y0=0100, Z0=1; by bit they are bit0: X0=0,Y0=0; bit1: X1=0,Y1=0; bit2: X2=1,Y2=1; bit3: X3=1,Y3=0. Using the relationships of Figure-II, Pi=Xi xor Yi, Gi=XiYi, Zi+1=Gi + PiZi, Si=Pi xor Zi. The initial reset is treated as the all-0 state. bit0: P0=0, G0=0; Z0 goes to 1 at 0 ns, so S0=0 xor 1 becomes stable as 1 after the second XOR at 20 ns; Z1=0 remains stable. bit1: X1=Y1=0 and Z1=0, so P1=0, G1=0, S1=0, Z2=0, with no new later stable time. bit2: X2=Y2=1, therefore P2=1 xor 1=0, G2=1; G2 is formed by AND at 15 ns, then through OR at 25 ns makes Z3=1; S2=0 xor Z2=0, remaining 0. bit3: X3=1,Y3=0, therefore P3=1 is formed after the first XOR delay at 20 ns, G3=0; bit3 receives Z3=1 at 25 ns, and at this time P3 has already formed, so the AND output PiZi becomes 1 at max(20,25)+15=40 ns, then after an OR delay of 10 ns, makes the final carry Z4 stable as 1 at 50 ns. S3 enters the second XOR from P3 and Z3, and reaches its final value 0 at the latest at 25+20=45 ns. Among all outputs S0,S1,S2,S3,Z4, the latest to become stable is Z4, and the time is 50 ns.

Figure I shows a 4-bits ripple carry adder realized using full adders, and Figure II shows the circuit of a full-adder (FA). The propagation delay of the XOR, AND, and OR gates in Figure II are 20 ns, 15 ns, and 10 ns, respectively. Assume all the inputs to the 4-bit adder are initially reset to \( Z_4 \).
At \( t = 0 \), the inputs to the 4-bit adder are changed to \( X_3X_2X_1X_0 = 1100 \), \( Y_3Y_2Y_1Y_0 = 0100 \), and \( Z_0 = 1 \). The output of the ripple carry adder will be stable at \( t \) (in ns) = ________.

method.method_draft: First describe the two figures: identify the four cascaded FAs in Figure I and the XOR-XOR/AND-AND-OR full-adder structure in Figure II. Then read from the text the input change X=1100, Y=0100, Z0=1 and gate delays XOR=20 ns, AND=15 ns, OR=10 ns. Build an event table for bits 0 to 3. For each bit, compute P_i, G_i, carry Z_{i+1}, and S_i arrival/stability times using the actual final bit values. Track that bit 2 generates Z3 through XiYi then OR, while bit 3 receives Z3 and uses its already-formed propagate signal to determine the final carry Z4. Compare the latest stabilization times of all sum outputs and the final carry; the maximum is 50 ns.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图左侧的 Figure-I 是 4 位串行进位加法器，由 4 个 FA 方块级联构成；最右侧 FA 接最低位 X0,Y0 和输入进位 Z0，向左依次产生 Z1、Z2、Z3，最左侧输出最终进位 Z4，各级底部输出 S0 到 S3。附图右侧的 Figure-II 是一个全加器结构：Xi 和 Yi 先进入 XOR 得到传播信号 Pi，再与 Zi 进入第二个 XOR 得到 Si；同时 Xi 和 Yi 进入 AND 得到生成项 Gi，Pi 和 Zi 进入另一个 AND，两个 AND 输出再经 OR 得到 Zi+1。题中给定 XOR、AND、OR 延迟分别为 20 ns、15 ns、10 ns。推理：输入在 t=0 变为 X3X2X1X0=1100，Y3Y2Y1Y0=0100，Z0=1；按位为 bit0: X0=0,Y0=0；bit1: X1=0,Y1=0；bit2: X2=1,Y2=1；bit3: X3=1,Y3=0。采用 Figure-II 的关系 Pi=Xi xor Yi，Gi=XiYi，Zi+1=Gi + PiZi，Si=Pi xor Zi。初始复位按全 0 状态处理。bit0：P0=0、G0=0；Z0 在 0 ns 到 1，所以 S0=0 xor 1 经第二个 XOR 在 20 ns 稳定为 1；Z1=0 保持稳定。bit1：X1=Y1=0 且 Z1=0，所以 P1=0、G1=0、S1=0、Z2=0，无新的较晚稳定时间。bit2：X2=Y2=1，因此 P2=1 xor 1=0，G2=1；G2 由 AND 在 15 ns 形成，随后经 OR 在 25 ns 使 Z3=1；S2=0 xor Z2=0，保持为 0。bit3：X3=1,Y3=0，因此 P3=1 在第一 XOR 延迟后于 20 ns 形成，G3=0；bit3 在 25 ns 收到 Z3=1，此时 P3 已经形成，所以 PiZi 这个 AND 输出在 max(20,25)+15=40 ns 变为 1，再经 OR 延迟 10 ns，使最终进位 Z4 在 50 ns 稳定为 1。S3 由 P3 和 Z3 进入第二 XOR，最晚在 25+20=45 ns 达到最终值 0。所有输出 S0,S1,S2,S3,Z4 中最晚稳定的是 Z4，时间为 50 ns。

raw_record.original_question:
Figure I shows a 4-bits ripple carry adder realized using full adders, and Figure II shows the circuit of a full-adder (FA). The propagation delay of the XOR, AND, and OR gates in Figure II are 20 ns, 15 ns, and 10 ns, respectively. Assume all the inputs to the 4-bit adder are initially reset to \( Z_4 \).
At \( t = 0 \), the inputs to the 4-bit adder are changed to \( X_3X_2X_1X_0 = 1100 \), \( Y_3Y_2Y_1Y_0 = 0100 \), and \( Z_0 = 1 \). The output of the ripple carry adder will be stable at \( t \) (in ns) = ________.
raw_record.final_cot: Image description: Figure-I on the left side of the attached figure is a 4-bit ripple-carry adder, formed by cascading 4 FA blocks; the rightmost FA is connected to the least significant bits X0,Y0 and the input carry Z0, producing Z1, Z2, and Z3 successively to the left, the leftmost side outputs the final carry Z4, and the bottom of each stage outputs S0 to S3. Figure-II on the right side of the attached figure is a full-adder structure: Xi and Yi first enter XOR to obtain the propagate signal Pi, then enter a second XOR with Zi to obtain Si; meanwhile Xi and Yi enter AND to obtain the generate term Gi, Pi and Zi enter another AND, and the outputs of the two ANDs then pass through OR to obtain Zi+1. The problem gives XOR, AND, and OR delays as 20 ns, 15 ns, and 10 ns respectively. Reasoning: the inputs change at t=0 to X3X2X1X0=1100, Y3Y2Y1Y0=0100, Z0=1; by bit they are bit0: X0=0,Y0=0; bit1: X1=0,Y1=0; bit2: X2=1,Y2=1; bit3: X3=1,Y3=0. Using the relationships of Figure-II, Pi=Xi xor Yi, Gi=XiYi, Zi+1=Gi + PiZi, Si=Pi xor Zi. The initial reset is treated as the all-0 state. bit0: P0=0, G0=0; Z0 goes to 1 at 0 ns, so S0=0 xor 1 becomes stable as 1 after the second XOR at 20 ns; Z1=0 remains stable. bit1: X1=Y1=0 and Z1=0, so P1=0, G1=0, S1=0, Z2=0, with no new later stable time. bit2: X2=Y2=1, therefore P2=1 xor 1=0, G2=1; G2 is formed by AND at 15 ns, then through OR at 25 ns makes Z3=1; S2=0 xor Z2=0, remaining 0. bit3: X3=1,Y3=0, therefore P3=1 is formed after the first XOR delay at 20 ns, G3=0; bit3 receives Z3=1 at 25 ns, and at this time P3 has already formed, so the AND output PiZi becomes 1 at max(20,25)+15=40 ns, then after an OR delay of 10 ns, makes the final carry Z4 stable as 1 at 50 ns. S3 enters the second XOR from P3 and Z3, and reaches its final value 0 at the latest at 25+20=45 ns. Among all outputs S0,S1,S2,S3,Z4, the latest to become stable is Z4, and the time is 50 ns.
